title: Arrays and indexes
summary: Making, reading and measuring an array.

steps.title: An array
steps.say: An array holds a fixed number of values of one type, in numbered slots.

board.code:
int[] values = {4, 1, 3};
int first = values[0];   // 4
int last = values[2];    // 3
int n = values.length;   // 3

steps.title: The last slot
steps.say: Because counting starts at 0, the last index is `length - 1`. Asking for `values[3]` here crashes with an out-of-bounds error.

board.code:
values[values.length - 1]   // the last value
values[values.length]       // crash!

steps.title: Looping over it
steps.say: This loop visits every slot once, in order.
